reading.title: Enclosure for the County Council's consideration is a Resolution approving the terms and conditions of a Payments in Lieu of Taxes ("PILOT") Agreement

candidates.quote: The Owner, New Carrollton Affordable Senior I, LLC, will form an entity for the purpose of constructing a one hundred twelve (112) unit affordable rental housing community for seniors earning seventy percent (70%) or below of the Area Median Income (“AMI”), located at 4051 Garden City Drive, Hyattsville, Maryland 20785.
candidates.wording: constructing a one hundred twelve (112) unit

candidates.quote: The Owner, New Carrollton Affordable Senior I, LLC, will form an entity for the purpose of constructing a one hundred twelve (112) unit affordable rental housing community for seniors earning seventy percent (70%) or below of the Area Median Income (“AMI”), located at 4051 Garden City Drive, Hyattsville, Maryland 20785.
candidates.wording: earning seventy percent (70%) or below of the Area Median Income

candidates.quote: The PILOT will require the Owner to make a mandatory annual payment to the County in an amount of no less than approximately forty seven thousand, six hundred dollars or four hundred twenty-five dollars per unit ($47,600 or $425 per unit) for the first year.
candidates.value: $47,600 or $425 per unit for the first year

candidates.quote: Thereafter, the required payment for these affordable units will increase by two percent (2%) for each subsequent tax year.
candidates.value: increase by 2% each subsequent tax year

candidates.quote: The PILOT agreement will remain in effect for forty (40) years which includes the extended affordability period.
candidates.wording: remain in effect for forty (40) years
